apk.nativeInstallScope: Native installation and play observations, with tested APK hash, are recorded separately in manual-verification.json.

scope: Extracted Korean data and 24,737 script instructions
Original-function differential fixtures for dice, new-game placement, navigation, supplies, combat, economics and script arithmetic
Independent navigation, trading, supply/unloading, shipyard, recruitment, appointments, equipment, contracts, gambling, battle, spoils and save/restore
Six original story endings with test-supplied travel, fame and battle prerequisites
Seven royal quest families, debt collection and actual A* sea travel
All 130 port arrivals and 889 building paths
Real-time battle movement, projectiles, ammunition, fleet AI, flagship duel and deterministic save/restore
Atomic game editor, speaker and attendant portraits, fleet hail reply and sea camera bounds
limits: Tests of story endings supply progression prerequisites; these are not six complete human playthroughs.
NPC global routing and offscreen combat use independent pathfinding and scheduling; they are not instruction-identical to the DOS runtime.
Original-function comparisons validate recorded inputs only, not every possible game state.
All 101 town layouts were reviewed in an overview gallery; exhaustive dialogue and form bounds were checked in a browser harness. This does not cover every device.
Versioned release validation records the exact browser and Android observations and their limits.
